cohort.selectionRule: deterministic next 30 current-active Binance Spot-USDT + USD-M PERPETUAL symbols after the completed ARP21-R2 cohort in current onboarding order; no R2 symbols reused.

portfolio.ranking: descending signal with lexical symbol tie-break
portfolio.longBook: top 10% of eligible symbols, equal-weight total +0.50
portfolio.shortBook: bottom 10% of eligible symbols, equal-weight total -0.50

costs.chargedOn: sum absolute portfolio weight changes plus terminal liquidation

failureRule: Any development gate failure closes ARP22-POS1 without threshold, universe, cost, holding-period or signal-transform rescue. Validation and holdout remain sealed. Development pass authorizes only fresh validation under the unchanged lock.
